description: This file contains ASN.1 encoding functions for the BoringSSL cryptographic library, including serialization routines for ASN.1 types, handling of sequences, sets, and primitive types, with internal helper functions and data structures.

methods.name: ASN1_item_i2d
methods.description: Encodes an ASN1_VALUE using a specified ASN1_ITEM, allocating buffer if needed.

methods.name: ASN1_item_ex_i2d
methods.description: Encodes an ASN1_VALUE with optional tagging, handling various ASN1 types.

methods.name: asb1_item_ex_i2d_opt
methods.description: Internal function for encoding ASN1_VALUE with optional parameters and tagging.

methods.name: asn1_template_ex_i2d
methods.description: Encodes ASN1_TEMPLATE with tagging and optionality.

methods.name: asn1_set_seq_out
methods.description: Serializes a stack of ASN1_VALUES into DER, optionally sorting for SET OF.

methods.name: asn1_i2d_ex_primitive
methods.description: Encodes primitive ASN1 types, handling tags and lengths.

methods.name: asn1_ex_i2c
methods.description: Serializes ASN1_VALUE to DER, excluding tag and length, with special handling for certain types.
